properties.name: v0.16.0
properties.notes: Cut 2026-07-27. A MINOR bump, and the FIRST since v0.11.0 that genuinely locks an older reflow2 OUT: PERFORMED_IN takes the schema from 55 edge types to 56, and the version stamp counts edge TYPES, so a reflow2 older than this refuses a design written by it — loudly, never silently half-read. Machines sharing a graph must upgrade together; docs/upgrading-to-v0.16.0.md leads with that. The enum growth in the same window (Verification.method += demonstration/observation in v0.15.0, Environment.env_type += simulation here) does NOT do this, and the doc says why. THE RELEASE THAT MAKES A PILE OF DOCUMENTS INTO A DESIGN. (1) SP-3b/BL-7 CLOSED after months: `ingest` needed a language model, reflow2 ships no provider, and the calling agent could not be reached mid-run — so the whole extraction pipeline was unreachable from a session. `ingest_step` is the repeated-round collect-then-serve handshake agent.rs had specified since SP-2 and nothing had driven; three or four rounds, NOTHING WRITTEN until the last (prepare rounds replay against a throwaway graph, so an abandoned handshake strands nothing), and NO server-side session state, so it survives a restart and works across seats. (2) It now recovers RATIONALE and TEST EVIDENCE, not requirements alone — and both land unasserted, a recovered Decision `proposed` and a recovered Verification `planned`, because an extraction is an agent's reading of somebody's document rather than the user's signature. Making that safe required tightening unverified_capability to demand a PASSING check: it had skipped on any incoming VERIFIES, so attaching a planned one silenced the question the detect-and-ask skill has always said it should not. (3) NEAR-MATCHES ARE ASKED ABOUT: ingest reads the two thresholds the schema had declared and nothing read, and the band between them reports instead of guessing; a structural token-subset pass catches what scoring cannot, since `Gateway` vs `API Gateway` scores 74 — below any threshold, because ratios fall as length differs. Imported from storyflow, which has fought this for years. (4) BL-95: coverage_report says what the design has never been TOLD ABOUT — every other check reasons about nodes already in the graph, so a design covering a third of a system reported the same `0 open gaps` as one covering all of it. Rolled up and ranked by mass, never a score: an artifact whose location is a directory claims what is beneath it. adopt now ends by asking. (5) req:design-the-simulator ACCEPTED and its first rung built: a check records WHERE it ran, so `proven only in simulation` becomes sayable — the reason for the schema change, since simulating first only pays if you can still tell model from reality afterwards. (6) BL-107: the export lineage chain is now CHECKED by the gate, found because I broke it for six commits while nothing noticed. Manifest: 78 artifacts with frozen cut-time checksums plus cmp:docs, cmp:skills, cmp:claims.
